candidate_decisions.title: Qwen Code 0.28.7
candidate_decisions.reason: Cross-control-plane takeover and removal of loop caps materially change runtime reliability and control boundaries.

candidate_decisions.title: LiteLLM 1.108.18-1.108.19 LTS
candidate_decisions.reason: False-success streams, tool-ID rewriting, guardrail and billing fixes materially affect agent correctness.

candidate_decisions.title: Codex 0.174 alpha builds
candidate_decisions.reason: Only alpha builds shipped; no stable release was available.

candidate_decisions.title: Ollama 0.40.19 rc0
candidate_decisions.reason: Only a release candidate shipped, with no stable artifact in the window.

candidate_decisions.title: OpenAI Python SDK 3.60.0
candidate_decisions.reason: The SDK exposes spend-alert, compaction and vault-update fields but does not establish a standalone product or API-stage change.

candidate_decisions.title: Trainium3 LTX-2.5 tutorial
candidate_decisions.reason: A training tutorial without a new model, chip release or independent performance result.

candidate_decisions.title: Hy-Embodied-Apexio-1.0
candidate_decisions.reason: The repository has no model card, weights or verifiable capability yet.

candidate_decisions.title: Inference-server rounding side channel media coverage
candidate_decisions.reason: Media coverage describes the already indexed inference-server side-channel study without a new artifact or correction.

candidate_decisions.title: Fitch analysis of BIS effects on Asian data centers
candidate_decisions.reason: The report analyzes the already indexed November 19 BIS rule and adds no new rule or implementation fact.

candidate_decisions.title: Songe seven-day review
candidate_decisions.reason: No public benchmark or independent reproduction changed the TRIAL judgment.

candidate_decisions.title: TML variable-loop seven-day review
candidate_decisions.reason: External pages restate publisher scores; no independent variable-loop evaluation changed TRIAL.

candidate_decisions.title: MemT-1.0-Pro seven-day review
candidate_decisions.reason: Independent analysis confirms textual retrieval still leads for detailed recall; WATCH remains.

candidate_decisions.title: Other fixed-monitor changes
candidate_decisions.reason: Stable sources were unchanged or contained no verified recommendation-changing update.

candidate_decisions.title: Remaining research and active-discovery candidates
candidate_decisions.reason: Candidates lacked the combined public artifacts, evidence and engineering value required for this run.

candidate_decisions.title: Exceptional general-news check
candidate_decisions.reason: No verified general-news event met the exceptional broad-impact threshold.

candidate_decisions.title: AI made self-hosting fun again
candidate_decisions.reason: Personal self-hosting essay without a distinct verifiable technical release.

candidate_decisions.title: Group chat where your AI talks behind your back
candidate_decisions.reason: A consumer group-chat prompt pattern, not a reusable engineering artifact or material platform change.

candidate_decisions.title: OpenAI cuts GPT-6.2 usage: Astra hits limits 40% faster, Sol 25% faster
candidate_decisions.reason: Social report about GPT-6.2 allowance changes lacks an official quota page or reproducible account evidence.

candidate_decisions.title: AMD-specific fork of llama.cpp
candidate_decisions.reason: AMD patch project is real, but only one user benchmark supports the performance claim; recorded as IGNORE.

candidate_decisions.title: Google Will Make AI Agents Use Its MCP Servers. The Gmail One Can't Send Email
candidate_decisions.reason: Official Google documentation confirms eight GA MCP servers and future agent-access, quota and billing rules.

candidate_decisions.title: OpenAI may be in cost control mode
candidate_decisions.reason: Cost-control interpretation contains no new primary-source fact.

candidate_decisions.title: Tracking Diseases Cured by AI
candidate_decisions.reason: The site aggregates cure claims without sufficiently attributable clinical evidence.

candidate_decisions.title: Claude sabotaging ML research tasks?
candidate_decisions.reason: A social anecdote about model sabotage lacks a reproducible task record or independent confirmation.

candidate_decisions.title: kandinskylab/Kandinsky-ImageSR-2.0
candidate_decisions.reason: MIT weights and a runnable 2x/4x Diffusers pipeline are public; independent quality evidence remains limited.

candidate_decisions.title: inclusionAI/Ming-Image-0.2-Design
candidate_decisions.reason: MIT weights and code are public with a testable design workflow and explicit hardware boundary.

candidate_decisions.title: ai-sage/GigaChat4-708B-A41B
candidate_decisions.reason: A complete MIT artifact family is public, but high verification cost and limited independent evidence keep it at WATCH.
